Purpose: 테넌트를 생성·활성화하고 로그인 사용자의 활성 테넌트 소속을 확인한다.
MainFeatures: 테넌트 생성; 테넌트 활성화; 내 테넌트 소속 조회; PlatformAdministrator directory 검색·상태·페이징
SearchConditions: mine에는 query 없음; directory: search·status·page·pageSize; ID/date filter는 실제 계약에 없음
InputItems: CreateTenantRequest(Code:string; Name:string); 활성화 tenantId:Guid; UpdateDirectoryEntryRequest(Name?:string; Status?:TenantStatus); 요청 subject는 JWT sub
OutputItems: 생성 {Id}; 활성화/update 204; mine 배열 {TenantId:Guid; Role:string}; directory page {TotalCount; Page; PageSize; Items[Id; Code; Name; Status; CreatedAtUtc]}
UserPermissions: PlatformAdministrator: 생성·활성화·directory; TenantMember: 본인 소속 조회; route/membership filter 적용
ImplementationGaps: 실제 source contract의 directory 조건은 search/status/page/pageSize이며 mine은 활성 소속 배열이다. UI smoke는 NotRun
DesignNotes: 기존 화면의 전체 목록 요구와 실제 mine API를 구분한다.

MainFeatures: 조직 생성; search·status·page·pageSize 목록; 상세; 이름·상태 수정
SearchConditions: search·status·page·pageSize; id/date filter는 실제 계약에 없음
OutputItems: 생성 {Id}; HTTP 201; page {TotalCount; Page; PageSize; Items[Id; TenantId; Code; Name; Status]}; update 204
ImplementationGaps: 실제 source contract의 목록·수정·상태 조건을 연결했다. UI smoke는 NotRun
DesignNotes: OrgManager는 현재 인증 정책으로 확인되지 않았다.

MainFeatures: 프로젝트 생성; organizationId·search·status·page·pageSize 목록; 상세; 이름·상태 수정
OutputItems: 생성 {Id}; HTTP 201; page {TotalCount; Page; PageSize; Items[Id; TenantId; OrganizationId; Code; Name; Status]}; update 204
ImplementationGaps: 실제 source contract의 목록·수정·상태 조건을 연결했다. UI smoke는 NotRun
DesignNotes: 조직이 선택된 테넌트 소속이며 active인지 service가 확인한다.

Purpose: 테넌트에 사용자를 초대하고 invitation token lifecycle 및 사용자 directory 상태를 관리한다.
MainFeatures: 초대 생성; invitation 검색·상태·페이징; token 재전송·철회·수락; 사용자 검색·상태·페이징; 사용자 수정; 상태 변경
SearchConditions: users: search·status·page·pageSize; invitations: search·status·page·pageSize; token/date requester 조건은 raw token을 노출하지 않음
InputItems: InviteUserRequest(Email:string; DisplayName:string); InvitationLifetimeRequest(LifetimeDays?:int); AcceptInvitationRequest(Token:string); UpdateDirectoryEntryRequest(Name?:string; Status?:UserStatus); SetUserStatusRequest(Status:UserStatus)
OutputItems: invitation page {TotalCount; Page; PageSize; Items[Id; TenantId; UserId; Email; DisplayName; Status; CreatedAtUtc; ExpiresAtUtc; AcceptedAtUtc; RevokedAtUtc; ResendCount]}; accept {UserId; Status}; revoke 204; directory page {TotalCount; Page; PageSize; Items[Id; TenantId; Email; DisplayName; Status]}
UserPermissions: TenantAdministrator for management; token-only accept; route/membership tenant boundary; tenant 내 email uniqueness
ApiEvidence: POST /api/platform/tenants/{tenantId}/users/invitations; GET /api/platform/tenants/{tenantId}/invitations; POST .../invitations/{invitationId}/resend|revoke; POST /api/platform/invitations/accept; GET|PUT .../users/{userId}; PATCH .../users/{userId}/status
ImplementationGaps: Invitation aggregate stores token hash only and delegates raw token delivery to an Adapter. UI smoke and HTTP smoke are implemented but local testhost execution is NotRun.
DesignNotes: Directory and invitation metadata are returned without raw token.

Purpose: 테넌트·조직·프로젝트 범위의 멤버십을 부여하고 목록·역할·회수·본인 소속을 관리한다.
MainFeatures: Tenant·조직·프로젝트 membership 부여; query-enabled 목록; Tenant 역할 변경·회수; 내 membership 조회
SearchConditions: 목록 query: subjectId·status·page·pageSize; mine은 활성 소속 배열이며 query 없음
OutputItems: grant {Id}; query page {TotalCount; Page; PageSize; Items}; update 204; mine {TenantId:Guid; Role:string}
UserPermissions: TenantAdministrator; 대상 subject active tenant membership 및 parent scope 검증; tenant route/membership 경계
ImplementationGaps: own-membership은 기존 활성 배열 계약을 보존; UI smoke·새 route testhost 실행은 NotRun
DesignNotes: PATCH는 Role 또는 Revoke 중 하나를 받아 domain ChangeRole/Revoke를 호출한다.

MainFeatures: 정책 생성; 정책 목록·필터·페이징; 정책 평가; 정책 수정; 정책 활성화 변경
InputItems: CreateAuthorizationPolicyRequest(OrganizationId?:Guid; ProjectId?:Guid; SubjectId:string; Action:string; ResourceType:string; Effect:string; Priority:int); EvaluateAuthorizationPolicyRequest(OrganizationId?:Guid; ProjectId?:Guid; SubjectId?:string; Action:string; ResourceType:string); 수정 Effect·Priority; enabled IsEnabled:bool
OutputItems: page {TotalCount; Page; PageSize; Items[Id; OrganizationId; ProjectId; SubjectId; Action; ResourceType; Effect; Priority; IsEnabled; CreatedAtUtc]}; evaluate {IsAllowed; ReasonCode; MatchedPolicyId}; 수정/enabled 204
UserPermissions: TenantAdministrator; tenant/org/project scope 검증; 변경·평가 audit
ImplementationGaps: UI smoke·새 evaluation/filter route testhost 실행은 NotRun
DesignNotes: Evaluation endpoint delegates to PlatformAuthorizationService; response omits policy body.

Purpose: 권한 감사 기록을 조회하고 무결성·아카이브·보존·작업 목록을 운영한다.
MainFeatures: 감사 조회; 무결성 계산·검증; archive 생성·검증·다운로드; archive job 목록·상세·재시도·검증; archive schedule; retention
InputItems: Authorization audit query parameters; VerifyAuthorizationAuditIntegrityRequest(FromUtc; ToUtc; ExpectedSha256); archive/retention/job request DTOs
OutputItems: Page {TotalCount; Page; PageSize; Items[Id; SubjectId; Action; ResourceType; Scope; IsAllowed; ReasonCode; MatchedPolicyId; OccurredAtUtc]}; archive download returns verified JSON octet-stream
ApiEvidence: GET /api/platform/tenants/{tenantId}/authorization-audit; GET /POST .../integrity; POST .../archives; GET .../authorization-audit/archives/{archiveId}; GET .../archive-jobs; archive-jobs/{jobId}; retention; archive-schedule
ImplementationGaps: archive download is tenant/checksum verified; new archive-job list testhost 실행은 NotRun
DesignNotes: Archive job collection and archive download are tenant scoped.

Purpose: Tenant·조직·프로젝트·DataSet 저장소 할당량 정책을 필터·수정·이력과 함께 관리한다.
MainFeatures: 정책 목록; scope·target·enabled filter; 정책 생성; 정책 수정; 정책 활성화 변경; history
InputItems: CreateStorageQuotaPolicyRequest(Scope; TargetId; nullable limits; WarningThresholdPercent; PlanCode); Update ExpectedVersion; Enabled IsEnabled·ExpectedVersion
OutputItems: page {TotalCount; Page; PageSize; Items[policy fields]}; history {before/after JSON and version fields}
UserPermissions: TenantAdministrator; tenant/org/project/dataSet scope 검증; optimistic concurrency
ImplementationGaps: targetId query is server-side; PlanCode has no separate query semantics; UI smoke is NotRun

Purpose: Tenant 범위 DataSet을 목록·필터·상세로 확인하고 생성·활성화·lifecycle을 관리한다.
MainFeatures: DataSet 목록; 조직·프로젝트·이름·상태 filter; DataSet 생성; 상세; activate·rename·archive·restore·delete
InputItems: CreateDataSetRequest(OrganizationId:Guid; ProjectId:Guid; Name:string; StorageAdapter:string; ContentFormat:string); RenameDataSetRequest(Name:string)
OutputItems: page {TotalCount; Page; PageSize; Items[DataSetSummary]}; detail {DataSet fields; SchemaRevisions}; 생성 {Id}; activate/archive/restore/delete 204; rename 204
UserPermissions: TenantAdministrator for lifecycle; TenantMember·route·membership for read
ApiEvidence: POST|GET /api/platform/tenants/{tenantId}/datasets; GET .../datasets/{dataSetId}; POST .../datasets/{dataSetId}/activate|archive|restore|storage/reset; PATCH|DELETE .../datasets/{dataSetId}; content routes
ImplementationGaps: lifecycle routes are implemented; new collection smoke is NotRun
DesignNotes: Collection filters and lifecycle mutations use the tenant-scoped service.

Purpose: DataSet의 불변 schema revision을 등록하고 page로 조회한다.
MainFeatures: schema 등록; current version; revision page 조회; revision 비교; rollback
SearchConditions: 전용 revision route는 page/pageSize page contract를 반환하며 version/date filter는 없음; diff는 fromVersion·toVersion
OutputItems: 등록 {DataSetId; SchemaVersion}; page {TotalCount; Page; PageSize; Items[Version; SchemaJson; CreatedAtUtc]}; diff {FromVersion; ToVersion; FromSchemaJson; ToSchemaJson; Changed}; rollback {DataSetId; SchemaVersion; RolledBackFromVersion}
UserPermissions: TenantAdministrator for write/rollback; TenantMember·route·membership for read/diff
ImplementationGaps: diff/rollback routes are implemented; version/date query remains unsupported; new route smoke is NotRun
DesignNotes: Rollback creates a new immutable revision copied from the selected revision.

Purpose: 콘텐츠 I/O와 Tenant/DataSet 사용량·이력·quota 이벤트를 확인한다.
MainFeatures: upload/download; DataSet·Tenant usage; history; quota event history; storage reset
InputItems: upload는 request body stream; download은 octet-stream; storage reset은 request body 없음
OutputItems: usage DTO와 history/event DTO의 실제 필드는 mapping.csv에 기록
UserPermissions: TenantMember; content write/storage reset/quota event는 TenantAdministrator; tenant boundary
ApiEvidence: GET|POST .../datasets/{dataSetId}/content; GET .../usage; GET .../storage-usage; GET .../storage-usage/history; GET .../quota-events; POST .../storage/reset
ImplementationGaps: storage reset route is implemented; aggregate usage list filter remains outside the source contract; new filter smoke is NotRun
DesignNotes: History and quota-event filters are source-backed; storage reset replaces the adapter reference and releases the previous storage.

MainFeatures: profile 생성·revision·이름 변경·삭제; profile 목록; execution 생성·목록·상세; details page; execution 삭제
OutputItems: profile page; execution page; execution snapshot; detail page fields are recorded in mapping.csv
UserPermissions: TenantMember for read/result; TenantAdministrator for profile/revision/create/update/delete; idempotency
ApiEvidence: GET /datasets/validation-profiles; POST|PUT|DELETE .../validation-profiles/{profileId}; POST .../{profileId}/revisions; GET /datasets/validations?fromUtc&toUtc&failureCode; POST .../{dataSetId}/validations; GET|DELETE .../{executionId}; details
ImplementationGaps: profile lifecycle and date/failure filters are implemented; new list smoke is NotRun
DesignNotes: Execution scheduling continues to enqueue the Worker task with compensation.

Purpose: Tenant Worker task를 필터·페이징·상세로 확인하고 등록·운영하며 성공 결과 bytes를 저장·스트리밍한다.
MainFeatures: task 목록; taskType/status/time filter; 상세; enqueue; cancel; force retry; result metadata/reference; raw result upload/download
SearchConditions: taskType·status·fromUtc·toUtc·page·pageSize; raw result Content-Type와 64 MiB 업로드 상한
InputItems: EnqueueWorkerTaskRequest(TaskType; PayloadReference; MaxAttempts) + Idempotency-Key; raw result HTTP body + Content-Type
OutputItems: page {TotalCount; Page; PageSize; Items[WorkerTaskStatus]}; detail status includes progress/fencing/checkpoint/HasResult; result {TaskId; TaskType; Status; ResultReference; Metadata?}; raw result file stream
UserPermissions: TenantAdministrator; route/membership; idempotency; Tenant/task reference match
ImplementationGaps: IWorkerResultStore와 개발용 FileSystemWorkerResultStore를 추가하고 운영 Object Storage Adapter 교체 경계를 문서화했다. HTTP/WPF smoke는 CI에 포함했으나 로컬 testhost 실행은 NotRun.
DesignNotes: Payload와 checkpoint 본문은 반환하지 않으며 raw result만 별도 저장소에서 Tenant 검증 후 스트리밍한다.

Purpose: 실패한 Worker 작업을 필터·페이징하고 replay 및 replay history를 확인한다.
MainFeatures: DLQ 목록; type/error/date filter; replay; replay history
OutputItems: page {TotalCount; Page; PageSize; Items[WorkerDeadLetter]}; replay history {TotalCount; Page; PageSize; Items[WorkerReplayHistory]}
ImplementationGaps: taskId/status는 item/detail field; UI smoke·new list route testhost는 NotRun
DesignNotes: Original task remains unchanged on replay.

Purpose: 외부 전달을 목록·필터·상세로 확인하고 관리자 수동 재시도를 요청한다.
MainFeatures: delivery 생성; 목록; status/host/error/date filter; 상세; manual retry
InputItems: CreateExternalDeliveryRequest(TargetUri; Payload; MaxAttempts) + Idempotency-Key; retry Idempotency-Key
OutputItems: page/detail safe projection; retry returns Delivery snapshot and WorkerTaskId
UserPermissions: TenantMember for read/create boundary; TenantAdministrator for create/retry; target allow-list; idempotency
ImplementationGaps: payload is omitted; UI smoke·new list/retry route testhost는 NotRun
DesignNotes: Manual retry resets a non-succeeded delivery and enqueues a new external-delivery task.
